basics.name: Guillaume Kuc
basics.label: 2D/3D Production · Creative Tools · Music
basics.summary: Versatile profile spanning 2D & 3D digital arts, music composition, and software/tools development. Formally trained in 3D Animation from École Estienne, Paris. Professional experience includes delivering complex interactive 3D maps, developing creative tools, extensions and workflow automations, crafting 2D digital illustrations and concept arts, and publishing music educational material. Lately, I've been focusing on deepening my technical arts skills in service of the French creative industries.

work.summary: Created interactive 3D maps for clients in mall, office, hospital, and university sectors while developing productivity tools to improve the production team's workflow efficiency.
highlights: Delivered high-quality interactive 3D indoor maps for enterprise clients (Orange, Loréal, SG, Lombard Odier, Engie, Unibail, Ikea, etc...)
Quality control, specs-driven process robustness, efficiency, parametric time estimates
SVG-based geometry problem-solving
Developed and integrated VisioMapEditor extensions, validator tools, and workflow automations that improved my and my team's efficiency
Navigated a large undocumented codebase
Tools: VisioMapEditor, Blender, AutoCAD, Illustrator, Figma, Vue.js, SVG & Paper.js, Node.js, GitLab, VirtualBox & Linux, Docker, various project management tools

publications.name: Portfolio website
publications.summary: Latest iteration of the website, first started around 2016. Built with Svelte and Javascript. Splashscreen, full-page carousel galleries, multi-modal integration, persistent music player, filtering, keyboard shortcut system and UX focus, config-driven architecture. Showcases art across 2D, 3D and music, with links to some published tools, and is paired with a companion blog.

publications.name: Chordex - Chord Relationships Catalog
publications.summary: Developed a standalone web-app, built with Vue.js and Pico.css, that lets musicians browse a catalog of all possible chord-to-chord transitions in the tertian harmonic space (192 possible moves given 4 chord qualities : major, minor, diminished & augmented) — a combinatorial, music theory-informed taxonomy tool. It also contains a chord progression generator that uses user-selected chord transitions as lego blocks to create fully original yet emotionally on target progressions. Features audio playback, keyboard visualisation, and affect-based tags.

publications.name: Gridz - Perspective Plugin for Photoshop
publications.summary: Developed a Photoshop plugin that solves a common gap in perspective drawing: a static grid only matches objects sharing its orientation, so Gridz lets artists rotate the whole grid in 3D space instead. Built with JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and Photoshop Extension SDK. Implemented bottom-up trigonometric transformations for accurate perspective calculation and created an intuitive UI for manipulating 3D space parameters. Published commercially on Gumroad.

publications.name: All-fourths Tuning, Improvisation - E-book
publications.summary: Self-published e-book teaching guitarists to use all-fourths tuning for improvisation. Created comprehensive diagrams explaining music theory concepts and developed a systematic approach to learning modes and scales in all-fourths tuning. Achieved 4.1 star average rating.

publications.name: The Encyclopaedist - Animated Short Film
publications.summary: Created a 3-minute animated short film as diploma project at École Estienne. Handled all production stages including storyboarding, modeling, rigging, animation, lighting, rendering and editing. Collaborated with composer Pierre Fontaine who wrote the musical score. Selected for screening at multiple international film festivals.
